tools.name: get_security_bulletins

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "api" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_patch, get_upstream_fix · Private data: get_patch, get_upstream_fix · Public sink: get_security_bulletins.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_patch, get_upstream_fix · Private data: get_patch, get_upstream_fix · Public sink: get_security_bulletins

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
